items.source: Will ask the parent factory if the bean cannot be found in this factory instance.
items.translation: 如果在此工厂实例中找不到该 Bean，将向父工厂询问。

items.source: Translates aliases back to the corresponding canonical bean name.
items.translation: 将别名还原为对应的标准 Bean 名称。

items.source: name - the name of the bean to query
items.translation: name - 要查询的 Bean 的名称

items.source: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - if there is no bean with the given name
items.translation: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - 如果不存在具有给定名称的 Bean

items.source: Return an instance, which may be shared or independent, of the specified bean.
items.translation: 返回指定 Bean 的实例，该实例可能是共享的或独立的。

items.source: BeansException - if the bean could not be created
items.translation: BeansException - 如果无法创建该 Bean

items.source: requiredType - type the bean must match; can be an interface or superclass
items.translation: requiredType - 必须匹配的 Bean 类型；可以是接口或父类

items.source:
Return a provider for the specified bean, allowing for lazy on-demand retrieval
of instances, including availability and uniqueness options.
items.translation: 返回指定 Bean 的提供者，支持按需懒加载获取实例，包括可用性和唯一性选项。

items.source: name - the name of the bean to retrieve
items.translation: name - 要检索的 Bean 的名称

items.source: a corresponding provider handle
items.translation: 相应的提供者句柄

items.source: This method goes into ListableBeanFactory by-type lookup territory but may also be translated into a conventional by-name lookup based on the name of the given type. For more extensive retrieval operations across sets of beans, use ListableBeanFactory and/or BeanFactoryUtils.
items.translation: 此方法进入 `ListableBeanFactory` 按类型查找的范围，但也可能根据给定类型的名称转换为常规的按名称查找。对于跨越一组 Bean 的更广泛的检索操作，请使用 `ListableBeanFactory` 和/或 `BeanFactoryUtils`。

items.source: The main intent of this factory is usage in combination with Spring's CommonAnnotationBeanPostProcessor, configured as "resourceFactory" for resolving @Resource annotations as JNDI objects without intermediate bean definitions. It may be used for similar lookup scenarios as well, of course, in particular if BeanFactory-style type checking is required.
items.translation: 该工厂的主要意图是与 Spring 的CommonAnnotationBeanPostProcessor配合使用，配置为"resourceFactory"以直接解析@Resource注解为 JNDI 对象，而无需中间 bean 定义。当然，它也可用于类似的查找场景，特别是在需要 BeanFactory 风格的类型检查时。

items.source: This factory resolves given bean names as JNDI names within the Jakarta EE application's "java:comp/env/" namespace. It caches the resolved types for all obtained objects, and optionally also caches shareable objects (if they are explicitly marked as shareable resource).
items.translation: 该工厂在 Jakarta EE 应用程序的"java:comp/env/"命名空间内解析给定的 Bean 名称为 JNDI 名称。它会缓存所有获取对象的解析类型，并且可选地也缓存可共享对象（如果它们被显式标记为shareable resource）。

items.source:
Allows for specifying explicit constructor arguments / factory method arguments,
overriding the specified default arguments (if any) in the bean definition.
Note that the provided arguments need to match a specific candidate constructor /
factory method in the order of declared parameters.
items.translation: 允许指定显式的构造函数参数/工厂方法参数，覆盖 Bean 定义中指定的默认参数（如果有）。请注意，提供的参数必须按照声明参数的顺序与特定的候选构造函数/工厂方法相匹配。

items.source:
Add the name of a shareable JNDI resource,
which this factory is allowed to cache once obtained.
items.translation: 添加一个可共享的 JNDI 资源名称，该工厂在获取后允许对其进行缓存。

items.source: Determine the type of the bean with the given name.
items.translation: 确定给定名称的 Bean 的类型。

items.source: Check whether the bean with the given name matches the specified type.
items.translation: 检查给定名称的 Bean 是否与指定类型匹配。

items.source:
Set a list of names of shareable JNDI resources,
which this factory is allowed to cache once obtained.
items.translation: 设置可共享的 JNDI 资源名称列表，工厂在获取后允许缓存这些资源。

items.source: true if the bean type matches, false if it doesn't match or cannot be determined yet
items.translation: true 如果 Bean 类型匹配，否则为 false（如果不匹配或尚未确定）

items.source: shareableResource - the JNDI name (typically within the "java:comp/env/" namespace)
items.translation: shareableResource - JNDI 名称（通常在"java:comp/env/"命名空间内）

items.source: shareableResources - the JNDI names (typically within the "java:comp/env/" namespace)
items.translation: shareableResources - JNDI 名称（通常在"java:comp/env/"命名空间内）

items.source: args - arguments to use when creating a bean instance using explicit arguments (only applied when creating a new instance as opposed to retrieving an existing one)
items.translation: args - 使用显式参数创建 Bean 实例时要使用的参数（仅适用于创建新实例，而不是检索现有实例）

items.source: the type of the bean, or null if not determinable
items.translation: bean 的类型，或者如果无法确定则为null

items.source: an instance of the bean
items.translation: bean 的实例

items.source: For a FactoryBean, return the type of object that the FactoryBean creates, as exposed by FactoryBean.getObjectType(). This may lead to the initialization of a previously uninitialized FactoryBean (see BeanFactory.getType(String, boolean)).
items.translation: 对于 `FactoryBean`，返回该 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，如由 `FactoryBean.getObjectType()` 所暴露。这可能导致先前未初始化的 `FactoryBean` 被初始化（参见 `BeanFactory.getType(String, boolean)`）。

items.source: For a FactoryBean, return the type of object that the FactoryBean creates, as exposed by FactoryBean.getObjectType(). Depending on the allowFactoryBeanInit flag, this may lead to the initialization of a previously uninitialized FactoryBean if no early type information is available.
items.translation: 对于FactoryBean，返回该 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，如由FactoryBean.getObjectType()所暴露。根据allowFactoryBeanInit标志，如果无法获取早期类型信息，这可能导致初始化一个先前未初始化的FactoryBean。

items.source: Behaves the same as BeanFactory.getBean(String), but provides a measure of type safety by throwing a BeanNotOfRequiredTypeException if the bean is not of the required type. This means that ClassCastException can't be thrown on casting the result correctly, as can happen with BeanFactory.getBean(String).
items.translation: 行为与BeanFactory.getBean(String)相同，但通过在不满足所需类型时抛出 BeanNotOfRequiredTypeException 来提供一定程度的类型安全性。这意味着在正确转换结果时不会抛出 ClassCastException，而使用BeanFactory.getBean(String)则可能发生此类情况。

items.source: Also, generics matching is strict here, as per the Java assignment rules. For lenient fallback matching with unchecked semantics (similar to the 'unchecked' Java compiler warning), consider calling BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(Class) with the raw type as a second step if no full generic match is available with this variant.
items.translation: 此外，这里的泛型匹配是严格的，遵循 Java 赋值规则。 对于宽松的回退匹配（具有 unchecked 语义，类似于 'unchecked'Java 编译器警告），如果此变体没有available，则可以将原始类型作为第二步传递给 BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(Class)。

items.source: This is a variant of BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(ResolvableType) with a captured generic type for type-safe retrieval, typically used inline: getBeanProvider(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {}) - and effectively equivalent to getBeanProvider(ResolvableType.forType(...)).
items.translation: 这是 `BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(ResolvableType)` 的一个变体，具有捕获的泛型类型以实现类型安全检索，通常用于内联：`getBeanProvider(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {})` - 并且实质上等同于 `getBeanProvider(ResolvableType.forType(...))`。

items.source: If a bean definition or singleton instance matching the given name is found, this method will return true whether the named bean definition is concrete or abstract, lazy or eager, in scope or not. Therefore, note that a true return value from this method does not necessarily indicate that BeanFactory.getBean(String) will be able to obtain an instance for the same name.
items.translation: 如果找到与给定名称匹配的 Bean 定义或单例实例，无论该命名 Bean 定义是具体的还是抽象的、懒加载的还是非懒加载的、是否在作用域内，此方法都将返回 `true`。因此，请注意，从此方法返回 `true` 并不一定表示 BeanFactory.getBean(String) 能够获取相同名称的实例。

items.source: Note: This method returning false does not clearly indicate independent instances. It indicates non-singleton instances, which may correspond to a scoped bean as well. Use the BeanFactory.isPrototype(String) operation to explicitly check for independent instances.
items.translation: 注意：此方法返回 `false` 并不能明确表示独立实例。它表示非单例实例，这可能对应于作用域 Bean。请使用 BeanFactory.isPrototype(String) 操作来显式检查独立实例。

items.source: Note: This method returning false does not clearly indicate a singleton object. It indicates non-independent instances, which may correspond to a scoped bean as well. Use the BeanFactory.isSingleton(String) operation to explicitly check for a shared singleton instance.
items.translation: 注意：此方法返回 `false` 并不明确表示单例对象。它表示非独立实例，这可能对应于作用域 Bean。请使用 BeanFactory.isSingleton(String) 操作来显式检查共享的单例实例。

items.source: For matching a generic type, consider BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(ResolvableType).
items.translation: 对于匹配泛型类型，请考虑BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(ResolvableType)。

items.source: Note that collections of beans are not supported here, in contrast to reflective injection points. For programmatically retrieving a list of beans matching a specific type, specify the actual bean type as an argument here and subsequently use ObjectProvider.orderedStream() or its lazy streaming/iteration options.
items.translation: 请注意，此处不支持集合形式的 Bean，这与反射注入点不同。若要程序化地检索与特定类型匹配的 Bean 列表，请将实际的 Bean 类型作为参数指定于此，随后使用ObjectProvider.orderedStream()或其懒式流/迭代选项。

items.source: All of those aliases point to the same bean when used in a BeanFactory.getBean(String) call.
items.translation: 所有这些别名在 `BeanFactory.getBean(String)` 调用中均指向同一个 bean。

items.source:
This method allows a Spring BeanFactory to be used as a replacement for the
Singleton or Prototype design pattern. Callers may retain references to
returned objects in the case of Singleton beans.
items.translation: 此方法允许将 Spring BeanFactory 用作单例或原型设计模式的替代方案。调用者可以保留对单例 Bean 返回对象的引用。

items.source:
If the given name is an alias, it will be translated back to the corresponding
canonical bean name.
items.translation: 如果给定的名称是别名，它将被转换回对应的规范 Bean 名称。

items.source:
If this factory is hierarchical, will ask any parent factory if the bean cannot
be found in this factory instance.
items.translation: 如果该工厂是分层的，当在此工厂实例中找不到该 Bean 时，将向任何父工厂进行询问。

items.source:
If the given name is an alias, the corresponding original bean name
and other aliases (if any) will be returned, with the original bean name
being the first element in the array.
items.translation: 如果给定的名称是别名，将返回对应的原始 Bean 名称和其他别名（如果有），其中原始 Bean 名称为数组中的第一个元素。

items.source: Is this bean a prototype? That is, will BeanFactory.getBean(String) always return independent instances?
items.translation: 这个 Bean 是原型吗？也就是说，BeanFactory.getBean(String) 是否总是返回独立的实例？

items.source: Is this bean a shared singleton? That is, will BeanFactory.getBean(String) always return the same instance?
items.translation: 这个 Bean 是共享的单例吗？也就是说，BeanFactory.getBean(String) 是否总是返回同一个实例？

items.source:
Does this bean factory contain a bean definition or externally registered singleton

items.translation: 该 BeanFactory 是否包含具有给定名称的 Bean 定义或外部注册的单例实例？

items.translation: 返回与给定对象类型唯一匹配的 Bean 实例（如果有）。

items.source: an instance of the bean. Note that the return value will never be null but possibly a stub for null returned from a factory method, to be checked via equals(null). Consider using BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(Class) for resolving optional dependencies.
items.translation: bean 的一个实例。注意返回值永远不会是 `null`，但可能是工厂方法返回的用于表示 `null` 的占位符，需通过 `equals(null)` 进行检查。请考虑使用 BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(Class) 来解析可选依赖项。

items.source: an instance of the bean. Note that the return value will never be null. In case of a stub for null from a factory method having been resolved for the requested bean, a BeanNotOfRequiredTypeException against the NullBean stub will be raised. Consider using BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(Class) for resolving optional dependencies.
items.translation: bean 的一个实例。注意返回值永远不会为 `null`。如果从工厂方法解析出的请求 bean 的 `null` 存根已确定，则将对 NullBean 存根抛出 `BeanNotOfRequiredTypeException`》异常。请考虑使用 BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(Class) 来解析可选依赖项。
